description: Google Fonts family records with category, weights, variable-font axes, subsets, designers, sparse popularity/trending ranks, dates, and specimen/CSS URLs. Optional enrichment adds license/attribution, source repository, languages/unicode coverage, CSS2 woff2 files with unicode ranges, and TTF download URLs. The icons mode emits icon records (name, codepoint, version, popularity, categories, tags, sizes, supported/unsupported families) from a single request. Typed error records use recordType=error; font records use recordType=font; icon records use recordType=icon.

fonts.description: Dataset containing the scraped Google Fonts families and any typed error records.
fonts.title: Google Fonts
